item.title: bussilab.pip v0.0.35
item.description: • Added upgrade_self() for upgrading bussilab, used by cron's self-update step. Added optional subprocess timeouts to all pip helpers.
item.content:encoded: • Added upgrade_self() for upgrading bussilab, used by cron's self-update step. Added optional subprocess timeouts to all pip helpers.

item.title: bussilab.pip v0.0.2
item.description: • Introduced install() and upgrade_all(), invoking pip with the current Python interpreter and supporting upgrades and user installations.
